title: calluna vulgaris var. pubescens
intro: Calluna vulgaris var. pubescens, commonly known as the woolly heather, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). The woolly heather is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the woolly heather include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic agent, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to possess significant antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
